english.title: Non motor vehicle fail to accord precedence at a pelican crossing

english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 26 of the Zebra, Pelican and Puffin Pedestrian Crossings Regulations 1997, section 25(5) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
IMPORTANT NOTE
The Zebra, Pelican and Puffin Pedestrian Crossings Regulations 1997 are repealed from 22nd April 2016. However, the regulations remain in force in relation to Pelican crossings that were established prior to 22nd October 2016 (6 months from the date of repeal) by virtue of regulation 14(5) of the Traffic Signs Regulations and General Directions 2016.
